description: arXiv:2408.10608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may encode biased associations from heterogeneous training corpora that are not immediately visible under ordinary prompting, but can surface when the model is steered toward particular demographic personas. Such behavior often manifests not as explicit toxic output, but as systematic performance differences...
